name: Roman numeral to integer
instruction: Implement roman_to_int(s) in roman.py: convert a valid Roman numeral string (I,V,X,L,C,D,M) to its integer value, honoring the subtractive cases (IV=4, IX=9, XL=40, XC=90, CD=400, CM=900). E.g. 'LVIII'=58, 'MCMXCIV'=1994.
verifyCmd: python3 -c "from roman import roman_to_int as f; import sys; c={'III':3,'IV':4,'IX':9,'LVIII':58,'MCMXCIV':1994}; sys.exit(0 if all(f(k)==v for k,v in c.items()) else 1)"
